user.title: SH Auto Update Manager
user.description:
Set up the Auto Update Manager by Smarter Homes LLC (smarter.homes).

This integration creates named update queues (e.g., Z-Wave Firmware, ESPHome Devices) with independent rules, execution modes, and controls.

Default queues are created automatically. You can add, edit, or remove queues in the integration options after setup.

abort.already_configured: SH Auto Update Manager is already configured.

init.title: Queue Manager
init.description: Manage your update queues. Select an action below.

add_queue.title: Add New Queue
add_queue.description: Create a new update queue with its own match rule and settings.

data_description.match_type: How to select update entities: by integration, area, label, or specific entity IDs.
data_description.match_value: Comma-separated values for the match rule (e.g., 'zwave_js,zwave' for integration match).
data_description.exec_mode: sequential = one at a time; parallel = all at once. Z-Wave is always forced sequential.
data_description.trigger_mode: manual = start with button press; auto_on_scan = start automatically when updates are found.
